name: massive_intent
description: Amazon MASSIVE smart-speaker intents, English, 60 options. High cardinality in a different domain from Banking77.

intent.instructions: This is a single spoken command to a smart speaker, transcribed, with numbers written out as words and the wake word sometimes left in. Which one of the following intents is the user expressing?

criteria.alarm_query: Reading back which alarms are already set.
criteria.alarm_set: Creating a new alarm for a time, including "wake me up at" phrasings.
criteria.audio_volume_down: Making the sound quieter or reducing the volume.
criteria.audio_volume_mute: Silencing the sound entirely, or telling the assistant to be quiet or stop talking.
criteria.audio_volume_other: Anything about volume that is not up, down or mute: opening volume settings, or changing which speaker or how clear the sound is.
criteria.audio_volume_up: Making the sound louder, or turning sound back on after it was muted.
criteria.calendar_query: Reading the calendar: what is coming up, what is pending, or what is scheduled.
criteria.calendar_remove: Deleting or cancelling an event, meeting or plan.
criteria.calendar_set: Creating a calendar entry or a reminder about an event at a time.
criteria.cooking_query: A cooking question that is not a request for a recipe, such as what to cook, or whether one ingredient can stand in for another.
criteria.cooking_recipe: A request for a recipe or for how to cook a named dish.
criteria.datetime_convert: Converting a time between two zones, or asking what a time here is there.
criteria.datetime_query: Asking what the time or date is, here or in a named place.
criteria.email_addcontact: Adding or changing an entry in the address book.
criteria.email_query: Checking, searching or reading the inbox.
criteria.email_querycontact: Looking up someone's contact details, such as their phone number or email address.
criteria.email_sendemail: Composing, sending or replying to an email.
criteria.general_greet: Greeting the assistant or opening the conversation.
criteria.general_quirky: A catch-all for anything conversational or open-ended that does not fit another intent: chit-chat, personal statements, philosophical or odd questions, and stray web lookups. Use this when the utterance is clearly addressed to the assistant but names no supported action.
criteria.iot_cleaning: Starting or controlling a robot vacuum or cleaner.
criteria.iot_coffee: Making coffee with a connected coffee machine.
criteria.iot_hue_lightchange: Changing the colour of the lights, or setting a specific brightness percentage.
criteria.iot_hue_lightdim: Making the lights dimmer or less bright.
criteria.iot_wemo_off: Turning off a smart plug or socket.
criteria.iot_wemo_on: Turning on a smart plug or socket, or a device plugged into one.
criteria.lists_createoradd: Starting a new list, or adding an item to an existing one.
criteria.lists_query: Reading back what is on a list.
criteria.lists_remove: Deleting a list, or taking an item off one.
criteria.music_dislikeness: Expressing dislike for the current track, or asking not to hear it again.
criteria.music_likeness: Expressing liking for the current track, saving it or thumbing it up.
criteria.music_query: Asking about music without starting playback: what is playing, what is available, or searching for an artist or album.
criteria.music_settings: Changing how playback behaves, such as repeat, shuffle or skipping to another song.
criteria.news_query: Asking for the news or current headlines.
criteria.play_audiobook: Starting, resuming or controlling an audiobook.
criteria.play_music: Starting music playing: a song, artist, genre or station of music.
criteria.play_podcasts: Starting, resuming or skipping within a podcast or spoken programme.
criteria.play_radio: Starting a radio station, named either by frequency or by name.
criteria.qa_currency: Exchange rates or what one currency is worth in another.
criteria.qa_factoid: A general knowledge question about a person, place or thing. The default for factual questions that are not currency, maths, stock or definition.
criteria.qa_stock: Share prices or stock market movements.
criteria.recommendation_events: Suggestions for things happening: concerts, festivals, local events.
criteria.recommendation_locations: Suggestions for places: restaurants, shops, hotels, somewhere to go.
criteria.recommendation_movies: Suggestions about films, including what is showing and when.
criteria.social_post: Writing or publishing something to social media, including a tweet or status update.
criteria.social_query: Reading social media: what is trending, or what is on the user's feed.
criteria.takeaway_order: Placing a food delivery or takeaway order.
criteria.takeaway_query: Asking whether a place does delivery or takeaway, or which places do.
criteria.transport_query: Directions, routes or public transport timetables.
criteria.transport_taxi: Booking a taxi, cab or ride.
criteria.transport_ticket: Buying or finding a travel ticket, such as a train or plane ticket.
criteria.transport_traffic: How heavy the traffic is, or how long a journey will take because of it.
